items.concept: Eyes burst across his chest and face. The eye-covered claw arm now drags on the ground, and the brass lamp has grown into his right forearm in place of the hand.
items.flavor: The light used to be something he carried. Now it is something he is. Don't look at the lamp. Every eye on him is already looking at you.

items.concept: His face has become two huge eyes under the sou'wester. The eyed arm ends in a hooked claw, and the lamp is still held on a pole (not fused yet).
items.flavor: He has two eyes now where his face was. He wanted to see the ships come in. Be careful what you want in this town.

items.concept: A hulking flesh brute on clawed limbs. The lamp has become a burning amber heart inside a fanged chest-maw, with the shrunken bearded head and hat on top. (Has a slight floor shadow.)
items.flavor: The lighthouse has a heart now. It beats amber. It wants yours for oil. You have about one minute of oil left. Spend it.

items.concept: A living lighthouse tower of flesh. The eye-arm coils around it, a giant amber eye-lamp sits at the top, and his face is pressed into the wall. (The beam is translucent green, so it needs cleanup.)
items.flavor: He finally became the light. Ships see him for miles. None of them turn back. You're not a ship. Turn back.
